ammonia.reason: Alkaline distillation 110-280 mg/kg ammonia in well-matured French Brie from amino acid deamination by P. camemberti/yeasts.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol and indole not detected in Brie; washed-rind Brevibacterium activity absent in white-mold make.

bitter.reason: Moderate proteolysis by rennet and P. camemberti aspartyl proteases yields hydrophobic peptides, mostly degraded.

blue_moldy.reason: Methyl ketones 2-heptanone 2.5-15 ppm and 2-nonanone 3.1-8.4 ppm from Penicillium beta-oxidation of free fatty acids.

browning.reason: High moisture ~48% and pH ~6.4 with low residual sugar limit Maillard; only slow rind Maillard/caramelization.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate metabolism by mesophilic Lactococcus plus milk fat lactones; diacetyl not accumulated in Brie.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic 105 ppm, hexanoic 35 ppm, octanoic 17-82 ppm from lipolysis by Penicillium lipases and esterases.

creaminess.reason: High fat 27.7% with rind-to-center proteolysis and pH rise to ~7.0 causing calcium phosphate solubilization and softening.

crumbliness.reason: Deacidified, proteolyzed paste with moisture ~48% flows rather than fractures; calcium-depleted casein network.

firmness.reason: Soft-bloomy paste ripened 4-5 weeks; intact rind but interior spoonable due to Penicillium proteolysis.

floral_honey.reason: 2-phenylethanol only 0.01 ppm in mature French Brie from phenylalanine catabolism; very low phenylacetaldehyde.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate 0.012 ppm and ethyl hexanoate 0.021-3.44 ppm from esterification of free fatty acids by mold esterases.

goaty.reason: 3-methylbutanoic 50 ppm present but goat-specific 4-methyl/4-ethyloctanoic acids not detected in cow-milk Brie.

malty_nutty.reason: 3-methylbutanal, 2-methylbutanal and 2-methylpropanal not detected in Brie; low Strecker aldehyde formation.

melt.reason: Rennet curd, pH ~6.4, moisture ~48% and intact casein that flows on heating; not acid-set non-melter.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol 0.123-0.41 ppm from linoleic acid lipoxygenase by P. camemberti gives signature mushroom rind note.

oil_off.reason: 27.7% fat in softened matrix releases some free oil on heating but emulsion largely held by partially hydrolyzed protein.

smoky.reason: Guaiacol not found and no smoking step; no wood-smoke phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic 75 ppm low and lactic acid consumed by yeasts/mold with pH rise from 4.6 to 6.4-7.0; little vinegar sourness.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading; rennet/white-mold curd does not form aligned paracasein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Dimethyl disulfide 0.034 ppm and trisulfide 0.03 ppm only in very mature French Brie from methionine demethiolation.

sweet.reason: Lactose exhausted during 10-21 day ripening; faint sweetness from glycerol, free amino acids and low salt masking.

umami.reason: Elevated soluble nitrogen and glutamate from extensive surface proteolysis by P. camemberti and rennet.
